role_descriptions.inventory: Read-only provenance and campaign-inventory specialist. Establishes exactly what artifacts exist in each independent discovery campaign and reconstructs their internal provenance without interpreting model quality.
role_descriptions.taxonomist: Cross-campaign model-taxonomy specialist. Aligns models by mathematical and generative structure rather than by name, identifies equivalent, nested, related, and genuinely distinct hypotheses, and builds the cross-campaign model map.
role_descriptions.mathematician: Mathematical reconciliation specialist. Compares state variables, update equations, stochastic dependence, memory structure and parameterization across campaigns to determine structural equivalence, nesting and meaningful distinctions.
role_descriptions.implementation_auditor: Source-code and ABCA implementation auditor. Inspects generated plugins and calibration artifacts to determine whether similarly named models are actually equivalent and whether differently named models implement the same underlying rule.
role_descriptions.evidence_analyst: Cross-campaign evidence specialist. Compares screening evidence while respecting differences in subsets, seeds, metrics and calibration. Identifies recurrent successes and failures without naively averaging incompatible scores or rankings.
role_descriptions.biologist: Biological interpretation specialist. Identifies recurring biological or phenomenological principles across campaigns and distinguishes robust recurring hypotheses from run-specific implementations.
role_descriptions.critic: Independent adversarial reconciliation reviewer. Searches for false equivalences, hidden implementation differences, unsupported consensus, ranking artefacts, duplicated models and unjustified exclusions.
role_descriptions.curator: Scientific synthesis and handoff specialist. Maintains the canonical crosswalk, recurrent-principle map, consolidated candidate portfolio and final human-validation handoff while preserving full provenance.
role_descriptions.orchestrator: Coordinates cross-campaign reconciliation. Enforces the separation between discovery, reconciliation and later validation; prevents new model invention, refitting, resimulation and unjustified aggregation of screening scores.
